facts.fact: Uganda Communications Commission Executive Director Nyombi Thembo, speaking on AI-generated deepfakes and disinformation, said the Computer Misuse (Amendment) Act 2022 is in full effect, with up to 7 years' imprisonment or a Shs10 million fine for hate speech, cyber stalking and malicious information.

UGA.note: No government use of AI is stated.
